label: pet2bids
description: Convert PET DICOMs with optional metadata overlay for fields DICOM does not carry.

fields.label: Session
fields.help: Letters and digits only. Empty = omit the ses-* layer.

fields.label: Strip dates
fields.help: Off keeps AcquisitionDateTime so chronological ordering works; PHI is stripped either way. On strips dates too.

fields.label: Metadata file
fields.help: Optional JSON of PET fields (TracerName, InjectedRadioactivity, ModeOfAdministration, …). Operator values win over dcm2niix-derived ones.
